slack._comment: Prefer an environment variable over storing the token here. The client checks, in order: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN, SLACK_USER_TOKEN, then this file, then the Windows User environment. Scopes: chat:write, channels:read, channels:history, channels:join. Add channels:manage (bot) or channels:write (user token) only if you want it to create the channel for you.
